proc parseJsdoc(raw: string): JsdocInfo {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Parses a doc-comment body. Description is everything before the first @tag; @param, @returns/@return, @example (kept verbatim, may repeat) and @deprecated are understood, the rest ignored.
